purpose: Close vNext with finite, auditable gates while preserving future improvements as NEXT_VERSION_CANDIDATE.
north_star: Owner-governed, evidence-grounded, recoverable, self-improving autonomous operating system

required_now: North Star logical architecture and provider-neutral adapter boundaries
Deterministic bootstrap and dual physical recovery evidence
Self-Evolution Protocol with fail-closed Fast Path classification
Fail-closed Authorization Contract enforced by governed Execution adapters
Exact-head independent material architecture review for this North Star candidate
not_required_now: All logical institutions as separate agents/services
Quota circuit breakers and observability SLO implementation

finding_taxonomy.CURRENT_VERSION_MATERIAL_BLOCK: A defect that invalidates a vNext acceptance claim or required vNext control; must be fixed before vNext acceptance.
finding_taxonomy.DEFERRED_NORTH_STAR_MATERIAL_GAP: Material for a later North Star capability level or milestone but outside vNext claims; must have a named future gate and must not be represented as already solved.
finding_taxonomy.MINOR_AUTOFIX: Non-material consistency or clarity issue safe to correct without widening scope.
finding_taxonomy.NEXT_VERSION_CANDIDATE: Beneficial nonblocking improvement that does not invalidate current vNext acceptance claims.

blocking_acceptance_criteria.criterion: No unresolved CURRENT_VERSION_MATERIAL_BLOCK after Lab Architecture Gap Analysis and Core disposition; every DEFERRED_NORTH_STAR_MATERIAL_GAP has an explicit future milestone and does not invalidate a vNext claim
Vault clears canonical identity, anti-rollback, provenance, bootstrap and dual-root recovery as no MATERIAL_BLOCK for the reviewed scope
North Star Architecture defines provider/tool/source adapter boundaries and provider-independent Multiverse identity

Self-Evolution Protocol prevents direct unreviewed production/constitution mutation and prevents change authors from self-classifying into Fast Path without a pinned deterministic classifier or non-author eligibility witness; ambiguity fails closed to material review
blocking_acceptance_criteria.evidence: pinned Self-Evolution Protocol + adversarial Fast Path test receipt

blocking_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Authorization Contract defines policy identity, actor, operation/target, permission ceiling, scope, data exposure, expiry, grant/Owner-Gate references, revocation and Safe-Mode generations; every governed Execution adapter rejects missing/stale/expired/revoked/out-of-scope/over-ceiling/Owner-Gate-missing/prohibited/unknown authorization state and cannot self-grant or downgrade permission classification
blocking_acceptance_criteria.evidence: pinned Authorization Contract + negative authorization test receipt

blocking_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Threat/security/recovery categories have either architecture coverage or an explicit deferred implementation plan with no material uncovered category for vNext claims
Final accepted-state recovery can be reconstructed without chat memory and material accepted-state bytes exist in at least two physical recovery roots
blocking_acceptance_criteria.evidence: final bootstrap + final recovery manifest + final restore receipt

blocking_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Keirin firewall remains unchanged: holdout sealed, DEV2000 C not consumed for new-lineage rescue, no protected RESULT/PAYOUT leakage, no validation trial consumption
Exact resume procedure resolves latest legitimate verified Keirin state and cannot be rolled back by stale pause artifacts
Auditor reviews the exact acceptance candidate and finds no release-blocking issue
Known nonblocking improvements are recorded as NEXT_VERSION_CANDIDATE or DEFERRED_NORTH_STAR_MATERIAL_GAP rather than keeping vNext open
No new spend or provider lock-in is required to satisfy vNext under current Owner constraints

This North Star architecture candidate receives an independent material architecture review against the exact review-stable head after Core fixes; absence of that exact-head verdict blocks Acceptance regardless of whether Lab reports no remaining gap
blocking_acceptance_criteria.evidence: independent reviewer exact-head verdict; reviewer provider is replaceable and not constitutionally fixed to Gemini

blocking_acceptance_criteria.criterion: Owner can complete review/recovery routing without routine Git/SHA/shell operations

definition_of_done: All blocking acceptance criteria PASS or are explicitly satisfied by equivalent stronger evidence; no unresolved CURRENT_VERSION_MATERIAL_BLOCK; exact-head independent architecture review completed; acceptance receipt pins exact artifacts/commit; rollback/recovery path verified; then core upgrade work pauses and Keirin exact-resumes from the latest legitimate verified canonical state.

reopen_current_version_only_if: material security/recovery defect that affects vNext claims
new evidence invalidates an acceptance claim
architecture_closure_rule.otherwise: Record as NEXT_VERSION_CANDIDATE or DEFERRED_NORTH_STAR_MATERIAL_GAP with a named future milestone

institution_compression_target.principle: Logical responsibility names may remain for compatibility, but implementation should avoid unnecessary permanent agents/services/chats.
steady_logical_implementation_groups: CORE including Resource and Evolution orchestration
EVIDENCE_KNOWLEDGE combining Source Intelligence and Knowledge Base
VAULT_RECOVERY combining Vault and Defense/Recovery custody functions while preserving least-privilege capability boundaries
EXECUTION_CONNECTION combining execution and adapter registry while remaining separate from permission-policy authorship
institution_compression_target.independent_reviewer: ephemeral independent review instance when governance requires; not a permanent thirteenth institution

deferred_north_star_material_gaps.gap: Common-origin evidence correlation and AI-derived evidence taint/lineage
deferred_north_star_material_gaps.future_gate: Before Phase C evidence automation or any claim of independent corroboration at scale

deferred_north_star_material_gaps.gap: Canonical-authority migration after permanent GitHub loss
deferred_north_star_material_gaps.future_gate: Before L5 provider-sovereignty claim or migration away from current canonical host

deferred_north_star_material_gaps.gap: Deletion/tombstone propagation across mirrors, derivatives and provider copies
deferred_north_star_material_gaps.future_gate: Before automated retention/deletion enforcement or sensitive lifecycle expansion

deferred_north_star_material_gaps.gap: Minimum evidence/control profiles for L3-L5 autonomy promotion

next_version_candidates: Quota/cost circuit breakers before broad L3 automation
owner_burden_target: Routine routing/research/file/SHA/recovery work remains system responsibility; Owner receives only material gates, consolidated exceptions and milestone roadmap status.
